## Definition

Adyen for Platforms is an integration family for platforms processing payments for their users. The captured getting-started guide describes a design process with Adyen for user data collection, online/in-person acceptance, payment/fee/commission splits, transaction risk, user payouts and reporting/reconciliation. This is the current Platforms documentation route in the snapshot; Classic Platforms, marketplace-specific guides and optional Issuing/Capital products require separate evidence and must not be treated as identical implementations.

## Integration path

The guide orders contact and fit assessment, implementation design, Adyen-provided test account and Customer Area access, build/test, live-account application, then separate live configuration/testing. The Customer Area resource list includes company account, merchant account, account holders and balance accounts. The overview names those resources but does not determine legal entity, merchant-of-record, liable/reserve balance-account, transfer-instrument identity or funds ownership for a particular platform.

## Evidence boundary

This is a 2022-last-modified page captured 2026-09-15. Adyen contact and fit review, test credentials or an application to go live are not current eligibility, compliance, user verification, capability grant or activation proof. Test configuration is not copied to live. Planned payment splits, transfers and payouts are not executed-money or receiving-bank evidence; use child guides and account-specific records for those questions.
